# Player span

A player span (`PlayerSpan(message_index, start, end, text, speaker=None, label=None)`) records where one Player (`knowledge/architecture/domain.md`) sits: the index of its message in the flattened snapshot and its character range in that message's text. `display_label` is the partitioner's `label`, else the text with a `"<speaker>: "` prefix. The Partition (`knowledge/architecture/masking.md`) fills one span per player in `PlayerSet.spans`; absence policies replace exactly those ranges and keep the rest of the text, and the renderers read labels from them, so nothing re-tokenises.

Package: domain (`knowledge/architecture/domain.md`).
